subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw publish `firecrawl-free` as an official provider while Firecrawl’s documented search API still requires Bearer authentication?
rationale: Anonymous search works today, but the upstream contract does not promise it; deciding to support that potentially unstable and privacy-sensitive boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Require upstream confirmation
options.body: Keep the provider pending until Firecrawl documents or confirms stable anonymous search, while preserving the independently supportable tool enhancements.

options.title: Accept undocumented behavior
options.body: Merge the opt-in provider while explicitly owning possible upstream withdrawal, support churn, and privacy-policy drift.

options.title: Drop the free provider
options.body: Remove `firecrawl-free` and consider landing only the authenticated Firecrawl search-option improvements.

recommendation.title: Require upstream confirmation
recommendation.body: Keep the provider pending until Firecrawl documents or confirms stable anonymous search, while preserving the independently supportable tool enhancements.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the strongest merged history across Firecrawl’s provider metadata, keyless behavior, plugin localization, and the adjacent opt-in keyless-provider policy.
